note:
Growth (any chart): ≥ 100% (< 5 mm), ≥ 50% (5–14 mm), ≥ 20% (≥ 15 mm) in long axis → re-enter the next size chart, or EUS-FNA. Imaging is contrast-enhanced MRI or pancreas-protocol CT. Stop at age 80.
* Mural nodule, wall thickening, MPD ≥ 7 mm, peripheral calcification, or biliary obstruction prompt EUS-FNA and surgical evaluation at any size. EUS-FNA can replace imaging at any point.
